question: What single quadratic refinement of \(J^2=1\) simultaneously derives the surviving Arf invariant, blocks all trace-vanishing representations, and renders the persistence drive identical to the loop’s invariance under conjugation?

responses_summary.grok:
The relation \(J^2=1\) supplies a linear involution (hence a \(\mathbb{Z}/2\)-grading or real structure). Its single quadratic refinement is the associated even quadratic form
\[
q(v)=\langle v,Jv\ran
responses_summary.sibling-alpha: The J-twisted Arf quadratic form q(v) := wt(v) + <v,Jv> over GF(2) simultaneously fixes the Arf invariant, annihilates trace-zero kernels, and equates persistence with J-conjugation invariance.
